jobDescription:
Satyam Jha
Data Analyst | SQL | Power BI | Advanced Excel | Business Analysis | Reporting Automation
Working with flat CSV files is great for quick analysis, but real-world analytics requires structured, scalable database modeling. 📊
I recently took the popular Superstore Sales dataset (9,994 flat transactional records) and redesigned it into a fully normalized Star Schema in MySQL. 
Here is what I built:
🔹 Problem: A single flat table leads to heavy data redundancy, higher storage costs, and risk of data anomalies.
🔹 Solution: Transformed the data into 1 central `fact_orders` table surrounded by 5 core dimension tables (`dim_customer`, `dim_address`, `dim_product`, `dim_product_category`, and `dim_date`).
🔹 Automation: Wrote a custom MySQL Stored Procedure to dynamically populate the date dimension for time-intelligence reporting across 2014–2018.
💡 Ready to Test: I have included both the raw dataset and the complete, runnable SQL scripts in the repo so you can clone it and run the normalization pipeline directly in your own environment!
🛠 Tech Stack: MySQL | Database Normalization | SQL DDL/DML | VS Code
📁 Full SQL code, dataset, and project walkthrough on GitHub: [https://lnkd.in/d2_tvZJN]
